title: Open the chosen table item
goal: Act on a QuickGrid row click.

runtime.reason: The callback is on the .NET 11 QuickGrid consumer.
runtime.name: .NET

sdk.reason: Build net11.0 with matching Razor/reference assets; the RC2 pin reproduces verification.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

language.reason: Canonical current sample language mode; the callback does not require a C# 15-specific construct.
language.name: C#

packages.reason: OnRowClick belongs to this separate NuGet package.
packages.name: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.QuickGrid

prerequisites: Use Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, net11.0, nullable and implicit usings; reference QuickGrid 11 with matching ASP.NET Core reference/runtime and SDK Internal.Assets browser files.
Register AddInteractiveServerComponents and AddInteractiveServerRenderMode, load blazor.web.js and activate an interactive component. No database provider or optional workload is required.
constraints: QuickGrid OnRowClick; interactive handler required. Static SSR and prerender alone do not dispatch .NET click handlers.
Keep a keyboard-accessible button or link for the same action; row clicks do not add keyboard focus or activation.
Nested controls bubble to the row; stop propagation when a control handles its own action. Validate authorization at the real action boundary; a row item is not authority.
The .NET 10 button comparison is compiled and executed, not an older-target OnRowClick route. No WebAssembly/Auto, other-platform, AOT or GA execution is claimed.

sources.title: QuickGrid interactive row callback, accessibility and bubbling

evidence.scope: Actual pinned Web SDK consumer. Separate real browser execution checks correct selected item, keyboard button, callback count and static SSR exclusion; no mocks.

humanProof.scope: Actual local Interactive Server browser checks and static negative control; no external resource. Broader rendering modes and GA are unverified.
